name: @clerk/nextjs
description: A LANE STAND-IN for @clerk/nextjs, used only in build/<app_id>.lane-console/ (molds/mold_v0/testing/console/render.py), never in a deploy, a build copy or the mold. It reads the signed-in person from the __session cookie the lane's throwaway world signs (the shell's own mock Clerk, scripts/lib/mock-providers.ts), so the console's own pages render signed in against a local API on an embedded database. The API still verifies that token itself. Clerk's own sign-in and sign-up widgets are not reproduced: /auth pages are not graded. Its types are Clerk's own: render.py links types/ to the installed package's dist/types, so the console type-checks against the real API.
